The Love Library sits at the heart of campus along Campanile Mall and has functioned for decades as both the university's central library and a hub for shared academic technology, a common arrangement at large public universities where library buildings also house networking equipment, servers, and help desk operations that support the wider campus. Facility footprints of this kind at CSU campuses are usually documented, if at all, in internal facilities and capital planning records rather than public materials, and in local building permit or zoning files that were not identified as covering this specific room during research for this entry.
